title: Update Lunar Climate Today content for all 27 Nakshatras

requirements.summary: Display lunar climate description and karmic lesson for the currently transiting Nakshatra in the CurrentNakshatraBanner component
acceptanceCriteria: Lunar climate description is displayed in the current Nakshatra banner
Karmic lesson is displayed in the current Nakshatra banner
Content updates automatically when Moon transits to a different Nakshatra
Display integrates naturally with existing pada details layout

file_operations.description: Update the expandable pada details section to display the lunarClimate and karmicLesson fields from the current Nakshatra data. Replace or augment the existing interpretive description with these new fields. Ensure the content updates automatically when the Moon transits to a different Nakshatra by using the existing reactive data flow from useCurrentNakshatra and backend queries.

Update the Nakshatra interface type definition to include the new lunarClimate and karmicLesson string fields, matching the backend data structure changes. This ensures TypeScript type safety across the frontend.

requirements.summary: Add editing capability for lunar climate and karmic lesson fields in the admin edit page
acceptanceCriteria: Admin edit form includes textarea for lunar climate
Admin edit form includes textarea for karmic lesson
Both fields save successfully via updateNakshatra mutation
Existing content is displayed when editing a Nakshatra

file_operations.description: Add form fields for lunarClimate and karmicLesson in the admin edit form. Include textarea inputs for both fields with appropriate labels and styling that match the existing form design. Wire the fields into the form state management and ensure they are included in the updateNakshatra mutation payload. Display existing content when editing a Nakshatra.
